newsitem.title: USA: America Service Group to take Q4 charge.
newsitem.headline: America Service Group to take Q4 charge.

text.p: America Service Group Inc said its fourth quarter operating results will reflect an earnings charge related to merger and severance expenses, for the anticipated expiration of its contract with the Georgia Department of Corrections, previously announced on October 16, 1996, and miscellaneous other items.

The amount of the charge will be determined in coming weeks, pending final contract resolution with the Georgia Department of Corrections, but will likely result in a reported loss for the fourth quarter 1996 approximating $2.5 to $3.5 million.
Further details will be forthcoming as they become available.
